change.summary: Ray of Siphoning heals from accepted final target health-plus-absorption loss rather than pre-mitigation LivingHurtEvent damage.

modifiers.before: Native postHitEffects heals caster by LivingHurtEvent.amount * getLifestealPercent before final armor, Protection, absorption and cancellation.
modifiers.after: Suppress only Siphoning early heal; after one native hurt call, if accepted heal native caster by max(0, targetBeforeHealthAndAbsorption - targetAfterHealthAndAbsorption) * native getLifestealPercent through native LivingEntity.heal.
modifiers.notes: No damage, resistance, spell power, mana, cooldown, native heal modifier or persistent spell state changed. Default native share stays1.0.

rationale.purpose: Prevent channel sustain from healing against mitigated, canceled, invulnerable or overkilled damage that did not consume target resources.
rationale.decision_source: User requested accepted-hit continuous-spell correction; exact final net pool accounting selected by Codex after installed bytecode verification.
source_evidence: DamageSources#applyDamage posts SpellDamageEvent, applies native resistance, and invokes LivingEntity.hurt once on the spell branch.
DamageSources#postHitEffects has exactly one heal invocation using LivingHurtEvent.getAmount before native mitigation.
RayOfSiphoningSpell#onCast contains exactly one damage call, DamageSources.applyDamage; its superclass AbstractSpell#onCast only plays sound.
RayOfSiphoningSpell#getDamageSource sets native lifesteal1.0; retained getLifestealPercent is the only healing share owner.

introduced.summary: Ray of Siphoning heals from accepted final target health-plus-absorption loss rather than pre-mitigation LivingHurtEvent damage.

history.summary: Ray of Siphoning heals from accepted final target health-plus-absorption loss rather than pre-mitigation LivingHurtEvent damage.

notes: No delayed state, hit replay, damage cap or duplicated resistance calculation.
Other spells and integrated singleplayer keep native healing.
Returned accepted=false never grants healing; accepted=true with zero net target pool loss grants zero.
Native caster.heal keeps LivingHealEvent modifiers and standard health synchronization.
unresolved: Same-call nested secondary damage or healing changes the net target pool and cannot be independently source-attributed by this stateless boundary; requires runtime trace.
Exact installed Mixin redirect application and actual equipped-target lifesteal need runtime acceptance.
